## About

Results-driven marketing leader with expertise in building and scaling demand generation, account-based marketing (ABM), and digital marketing programs for B2B SaaS companies across industries, including cybersecurity, healthcare, enterprise software, and AI. Strong track record in aligning marketing with sales to drive pipeline, revenue growth, and customer acquisition. I specialize in full-funnel strategy development—from top-of-funnel lead acquisition to pipeline acceleration and sales enablement. Skilled in managing paid media (LinkedIn, Google, programmatic), email nurture, lead scoring, lifecycle marketing, and intent-based targeting. Hands-on experience with tools like Marketo, HubSpot, Salesforce, 6sense, Demandbase, ZoomInfo, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and more. Passionate about using AI and automation to optimize performance, enhance personalization, and improve campaign ROI.

Total Experience: 20 years and 1 month
